description: For office supply, this intake form records operational need, standard-item match, substitution, delivery date, unit cost, order minimum, and storage capacity. Its supporting evidence includes stock count, catalog reference, price comparison, prior usage, approval, receipt, and discrepancy documentation.

subtitle: Office Supply Intake Form: office supply replenishment and control using requester, operational need, and stock count.
title: Office Supply Intake Form
use_case: Use the intake form during office supply replenishment and control when the office supply record must identify requester, worksite, supply category, item, quantity, current stock, preferred supplier, and accounting code. Complete the applicable handoff for order reference, received quantity, storage location, backorder status, requester notification, and inventory adjustment.
